findings.text: A stale comment block survives directly above the landed constant, stating the bound is the 11.5% booking error plus the 1.5% grid noise (an argument for rel=0.13) while TIE_BOOKED_CURRENT_REL at line 2726 is 0.02; the two blocks describe the same constant with different derivations, so a later reader re-deriving the bound from the file gets the wrong number.

The poloidal panel is drawn with spines, tick marks and tick labels on both axes, which the binding plotting rule forbids ('No axes, no gridlines on 2D plots. A poloidal panel is drawn with the axis off'); it bypasses the owners nova/media/ink.py:155 poloidal_axes (which calls set_axis_off), nova/media/poloidal.py:29 draw_wall and nova/media/poloidal.py:540 draw_nulls, and its generator fig_tie_pair.py is not in the tree, so the figure cannot be regenerated through the repository's painters.

The recorded negative control exercises rel=0.15 against rel=0.13 with the superseded seed-census numbers 129.234157/146.015393, not the landed TIE_BOOKED_CURRENT_REL = 0.02, so it demonstrates the bound-drift mechanism in general but never shows the landed bound refusing anything the restored bound admits.
